rationale: BASIS AND REFERENCE CLOSE. The report prints 7,365.46 for the same close; the QA reconciliation puts that 8.94 pts light, outside the 3-pt close tolerance, so the slice number governs and every level below is built on 7,374.40. ATR14 = 119.52 index points: the mean true range (TR = max(H-L, |H-prevC|, |L-prevC|)) of the 14 cash-session bars ending at D-1, window 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-23 with 19 Jun excluded. On full broker-day bars the same 14-session window gives 129.63 - the basis the linter recomputes on - and both are stated so every buffer can be checked either way. 0.25xATR14 = 29.88, 2xATR14 = 239.04, 2.5xATR14 = 298.80, 3xATR14 = 358.56, 3.5xATR14 = 418.33. The report never states ATR14 anywhere; its cards imply 96.0 through their buffers, which the QA feedback flags as unstated and wrong. REGIME AND FORK. The report calls the regime itself: its agent log records the consolidated label TREND_DOWN, its medium-term section reads 'Transitional-to-Trending Down / Bias: Bearish', the Kaufman read is 'Trending Down - Moderate' (KER ~ -0.45) and the volatility read is expansion. That label is taken as given (the strategies module reads the label and does not re-derive it) and it governs both the Trade 2 branch (TREND fork, short across the pivot) and the Trade 3 fork (TREND_DOWN -> 3A Momentum-Pullback, short). The report's own Trade 2 was built as a range rally-sell into a 7,398-7,415 shelf, which is the wrong branch for the label it declares; that geometry is not reproduced here. DIRECTION. The conviction score the report publishes is -0.77, |score| >= the 0.25 threshold, so the direction of the day is SHORT and Trade 1 is not suppressed on conviction. The score's listed contributors sum to -0.72 rather than -0.77 (a sixth 0.10-weight term is never named), but every reconstruction of the six-signal vector from the report's own reads - short-term technical bearish -0.25, medium-term trend-down -0.20, volatility expansion aligned with a down break -0.05, Kaufman -0.45x0.15 = -0.07, sentiment tilt -0.35x0.15 = -0.05, cross-asset CONFIRM -0.15 - lands between -0.72 and -0.77, comfortably beyond the threshold, so the arithmetic gap does not change the gate outcome. The report's agent log records that anchor as 'overridden per instruction' to the 14:30 UK cash open (16:30 broker). The strategies module's order-side-and-anchor rule and its non-overridable-gates rule both state that the anchor is not re-selected per run, per session or per convenience, and that no run-time instruction may be cited as authority for moving it, so the fixed 07:00 UK anchor stands and 16:30 is discarded. In June (BST) broker time = UK + 2, hence 09:00. STOP. Trade 1 stop rule: the tighter of (5-day swing extreme + 0.25xATR14) or (nearest resistance + 0.25xATR14), then capped at 3.5xATR14. R = |7,374.40 - 7,461.68| = 87.28 index points = 0.73xATR14 on the cash basis and 0.67xATR14 on the full-broker-day basis. Inside the 0.3-3.0xATR14 band on both bases (cash floor 35.86 / ceiling 358.56; full-day floor 38.89 / ceiling 388.89) and below 1.00xATR14, so NO wide-stop flag. 2R = 174.56 < 3xATR14 = 358.56, so no 'TP2 ambitious' flag. TARGETS. TP1 = entry - 1R = 7,374.40 - 87.28 = 7,287.12 (87.28 pts; 0.73xATR14, inside the 2.5xATR14 = 298.80 reachability test on the cash basis and inside 324.07 on the full-day basis). TP3 is the runner: time-stopped at the session close or price-stopped at entry - 3xATR14 = 7,374.40 - 358.56 = 7,015.84 (358.56 pts), whichever triggers first. Ladder for a short: stop 7,461.68 > entry 7,374.40 > TP1 7,287.12 > TP2 7,199.84 > TP3 7,015.84, monotonic. CONFLUENCES. Stop 7,461.68 sits 1.39 pts below daily R2 7,463.07 (within 0.15xATR14 = 17.93 of it) and 20.78 pts above daily R1.5 7,440.90 - a loose pivot confluence, logged but not relied on, since the pivot tiers are flagged indicative on their extremes. TP2 7,199.84 and TP3 7,015.84 are below every published pivot tier - no confluence claimed. INVALIDATION (separate from the stop). Daily close back above 7,502.30, the 18 Jun 2026 cash close and the top of the 16-22 Jun consolidation band that the 23-Jun candle broke beneath; it is the next structural level beyond the stop, 40.62 pts away, comfortably more than 0.15xATR14 = 17.93.
